label: representative_chamber
name: B-L, eta 0.3, 4 m^3/s, gas+plume arrival, 720 C

vacuum.chamber_volume_m3.basis: order of a 200 mm production chamber; only sets V/S (0.1 s at 4 m^3/s)

heater.areal_heat_capacity_J_m2K.heater.basis: 1 mm pyrolytic-graphite-like element, 2200 kg/m^3 x 1700 J/kg/K

heater.areal_heat_capacity_J_m2K.ledge.basis: 2 mm Mo ledge, 10220 kg/m^3 x 280 J/kg/K

sensors.pyrometer.spot_radius_m.basis: 10 mm spot at the wafer centre

sensors.pyrometer.noise_K.basis: reading noise; the bias budget is +/-2 K (audit 2026-10-03)

sensors.pyrometer.valid_min_K.basis: Si opaque enough at the pyrometer wavelength above about 600 C

sensors.rate_monitor.window_s.basis: laser reflectometry needs about one interference period (~140 nm of GaN at 633 nm, 8 min at 1 um/h) per rate reading

operating_point.basis: solved once on the calibration state (nominal pose, 70 mm / 8 A) and frozen: pyrometer spot held at wafer_C; N feed from the per-state balance (layout_comparison.solve_states) for the wafer-mean net rate; Ga centre flux mid-window from the reading (operating_optimum protocol). The definition's maps are the truth state's; the twin's controllers observe only the pyrometer and the gauge.

controller_model.basis: calibration state (nominal pose, 70 mm / 8 A); used by the twin's rate-monitor and BFM controllers
